news.headline: Lamar Jackson ruled out for Ravens at Browns; Huntley starts
news.detail: Ravens coach Jesse Minter ruled Jackson out on Oct 16 with an ankle injury, so Tyler Huntley starts again. Center Cam Jurgens is also out. The brief lists Jackson as BAL's QB.

news.headline: Eagles without Hurts and Barkley; McKee makes first start of 2026
news.detail: Philadelphia ruled Jalen Hurts out on Oct 15 because of a blood clot in his calf, and he was then placed on injured reserve. Saquon Barkley is also out. Tanner McKee starts against Carolina.

news.headline: Eagles also get DeVonta Smith back for Panthers game
news.detail: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks were listed as good to go for Sunday, per the team's injury report update from Oct 16-17. Philadelphia has lost three straight and ranks near the bottom in yards and points.

news.headline: Chargers missing Alt, Awosika, James, Jackson; Chiefs' Rice out
news.detail: Per the final reports on Oct 16, Chargers tackle Joe Alt, guard Kayode Awosika, safety Derwin James Jr. and corner Donte Jackson are out. Chiefs receiver Rashee Rice and tackle Josh Simmons are also out. Kenneth Walker III has no injury designation.

news.headline: Rams list nobody out vs. Cardinals; McDuffie, Curl questionable
news.detail: The Rams' final Week 6 report has no one ruled out. Corner Trent McDuffie (groin) and safety Kam Curl (ankle) are questionable. Arizona traded Marvin Harrison Jr. and is missing offensive linemen, which leaves Trey McBride as the main target.

news.headline: Packers without Josh Jacobs; Cowboys short at LB and CB
news.detail: Green Bay's Josh Jacobs is unavailable. Dallas ruled out Cobie Durant and Drew Shelton, and DeMarvion Overshown is out. Joey Porter Jr. was questionable. CeeDee Lamb has no final designation. Jordan Love threw for 367 yards last week.

news.headline: Penix and Caleb Williams both set to play; London has hip note
news.detail: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) was a full participant and will start. ESPN's inactives watch says Caleb Williams will play. Bears RB Kyle Monangai is out. Drake London was added to the report with a hip issue on Friday (limited, no game designation).

news.headline: Colts QB Daniel Jones practiced in full, no designation
news.detail: Jones had an ankle note but practiced fully and carries no game designation. Tight end Tyler Warren is questionable. Receiver Ashton Dulin and linebacker Jaylon Carlies are out. One report says the line moved toward Tennessee.

NFL.recap: No graded results or post-game reviews were included in this run, so there is nothing to recap for the NFL. The news check found the biggest lineup changes at quarterback: Lamar Jackson is out for Baltimore and Jalen Hurts is out for Philadelphia. The brief still lists Jackson as the Ravens' QB, so the BAL at CLE numbers may not reflect that.

College.recap: The model went 19 of 29 on winners, 16-10-2 against the spread and 19-9 on totals. Its average spread miss was 10.3 points against Vegas's 10.5, so it is about level with the line. Several misses came from game-flow luck. Memphis had 5 turnovers in a 31-17 loss to Tulane. Texas State scored 56 points on 9 trips inside the 40 against Colorado State.

lessons.lesson: When the model's total is 3+ points above Vegas's, the over has tended to hit.
lessons.evidence: 9 graded games had a model total 3+ above Vegas. The over won in 7 (Akron, Buffalo, Charlotte, Rutgers, Ball State, Pitt, Washington) and lost in 2 (Florida, LSU).
lessons.test: On past seasons, group games by model total minus Vegas total (0-3, 3-6, 6+) and check how often the over hits in each group. Need 20+ games per group.

lessons.lesson: Big misses often come from turnovers and finishing drives, which are hard to predict.
lessons.evidence: 6 reviewed games missed by 8+ points. 3 of them (Memphis, Texas State, East Carolina) had turnovers or drive finishing as a top reason.
lessons.test: On past seasons, compare model error with turnover margin and points per trip inside the 40. Check whether the misses are random or lean one way.

lessons.lesson: When the model picks a different favorite than Vegas, it has not done well yet.
lessons.evidence: 3 recent games had a different favorite. The model was right in 1 (Missouri State) and wrong in 2 (Cincinnati, Old Dominion). Sample is tiny.
lessons.test: On past seasons, list games where the model and Vegas disagree on the winner, then compare the model's win rate with Vegas's. Need 20+ games.
